'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Good Vibes'''. No username. Handwritten. DARK checked. Line 1 written Hunt Down And Destroy (V) → Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V). Line 2 Coruscant (SE); SE is a printing note, not (V). Line 3 Imperial City → Coruscant: Imperial City. Lines 7–8 Dark Lord Of Sith → Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith. Lines 9–10 Betrayer Of Jedi → Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi. Lines 14–16 Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek, Secret Apprentice. Lines 17–18 Cyborg Commander, Hunter → Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi. Line 25 Galen's Lightsaber, Gift → Galen's Lightsaber, Vader's Gift. Line 41 written Ni Chuba Na?? (V) → Ni Chuba Na? (V). Line 48 Endor Occ → Masterful Move & Endor Occupation. Lines 56–57 Weapon Lev → Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back.
